editorial_scope.route: Normal compact reevaluation; five old sections omit several major meaning/construction groups. Both original full assessments and original article are preserved separately.
editorial_scope.original_examples: All46 original English examples retained. The eat-a-lot/eat-lightly paraphrases retain their full pairs in usage, without unsupported lexical-looking frequency entries.
editorial_scope.sense_inventory: 12 pedagogical units: unspecified objects; activities/content; substances; physical/figurative filling; full-after-eating adjective; essence/qualities; knowledge/skill; eating/feeding; obstruction and blocked-nose adjective; taxidermy; marked rejection; regional spoil/failure/defeat. editorial_scope.core_omission: The old filling mnemonic cannot explain the general activities, rejection and failure groups without forced extensions; no adequate single contemporary kernel classifies all senses under v5. Omit the unified core and preserve actual meaning distinctions.
boundary_review_questions: Assess whether the combined obstruction plus directly related blocked-state adjective is clear enough with its explicit two-part title, definition and constructions.
Assess chosen mount comparison in the animal-preservation context, not general mounting.
Assess whether the twelve-block inventory is proportional; no fixed target count is imposed.
editorial_scope.peripheral_adjudication: Sports and ballot-box, textiles/pulp, container-loading, leather treatment, rude/vulgar uses have concise labelled treatment. Money slang and unverified regional exhausted/trapped stuffed are not promoted: lower learner priority or insufficient directly read evidence. They are not declared nonexistent.
editorial_scope.frequency: Retained headword scores preserve their original selected scope where possible; newly separated/added units get editorial broad bands. Free paraphrase scores removed. No measured corpus frequency claim.
editorial_scope.metadata: Current v5 body format; original entry_spec_v1 generation metadata retained consistently in entry and queue.
